_comment: Settlement tiers (DESIGN §3.3, DECIDED 2026-11-04). ORDER IS INDEX-STABLE: never reorder or remove, only append. Zones are in rings around the centre (ring 1 = centre + 6 neighbours = 7 hexes; 2 → 19; 3 → 37; 4 → 61; 5 → 91; 6 → 127). City 5 rings and metropolis 6 rings decided by Omer 2026-11-04 after the A/B test. GATES (DESIGN §5.8, Omer 2026-11-04): popMin is the population a settlement must reach before it may be upgraded to this tier — town 1,500, city 6,000, metropolis 36,000 (the model runs at scale ×3, see data/economy.json; the town and city gates were deliberately NOT scaled). popMax is informational only (= the next gate). typicalPop is the size range a settlement of this tier usually settles at under the ×3 model (village ~900–2,100; town alone ~10,000, with villages ~18,000; city orbit ~25,000–31,000) — draft, for the UI. 'hall' and 'granary' are the two buildings every settlement has from founding (data/buildings.json). CASTLES (DESIGN §3.5, Session 18): tiers 4–6 are castles (castle: true), appended so saved tier indexes stay valid. The LADDER is by rank, not by index: village 0 · small castle 1 · town 2 · medium castle 3 · city 4 · large castle 5 · metropolis 6. A castle has no residents; workHexes is how many hexes it works (its own first, then the best free neighbours in ring 1); its other numbers are in data/castles.json.

abandonment._comment: DECIDED by Omer 2026-11-05: a settlement whose population falls below abandonBelow people is removed at the end of that month; whoever is left walks to the parent (if any). Later an 'abandoned settlement' entity may mark the site for easy resettling. The threshold is a draft (×3 scale): cohorts are real numbers and never reach exactly zero.

upgrades._comment: Tier upgrades (DESIGN §3.2b rule 10, DECIDED 2026-11-07; numbers draft). A settlement at or above the next tier's popMin gate may be upgraded by the player: the money leaves the treasury and the materials the cluster's stockpile when ordered, the hall grows over `months`, and at completion the tier, its zones, hall and granary change. The city → metropolis step is a PLACEHOLDER (Session 15b, Omer's request to test new clusters): its real prerequisites (roads, an institution — metropolisUpgrade below) wait for Phase 2 session 2 and §4.3. Castle steps (Session 18, DESIGN §3.5): the cost of the next kind minus the current one (a PLACEHOLDER reading), built over `months` at full labour — `hands` spare hands of the settlements within the castle's reach (and a work-band standing on it) give full speed; fewer is proportionally slower.

metropolisUpgrade._comment: PROPOSED (DESIGN §3.3): prerequisites for upgrading a city to a metropolis. Not implemented until roads and institutions exist.
